gaps: Helm and Kustomize are not executed; only the authored YAML/JSON documents retained in the repository are indexed, so a templated value is carried through as the template text
a Kubernetes object with no metadata.name (a Kustomization, a raw List) is not minted as an object; its file is still a KubernetesManifest

an RBAC subject is keyed by name alone: subjects is a sequence of mappings and omega-yaml emits no per-sequence-item fact, so the sibling kind of one subject cannot be told from another's, and the same limit leaves a container unnamed
omega-json emits no definition.config_document, so a Kubernetes manifest written as JSON is stated as a KubernetesManifest and nothing else; every other rule is entered from the YAML document fact
